scene: The attendant happily hands you three travel transit passes.
picture: Inside the transit lobby on one level floor. The bearded player in blue cap and orange cardigan stands centre holding travel passes. On the far left, a blue water taxi floats by a canal dock. On the right, a glass funicular waits behind gates. On the far right, a red bicycle rickshaw sits parked.
shown: a blue water taxi waiting at a dock door on the far left
a steep glass funicular tram waiting behind iron gates on the right
a parked red bicycle rickshaw waiting by an open exit on the far right

variants.scene: A cheerful roller-skating panda hands you tickets for your next journey.
Holding your new travel passes, you look around the busy station.
Cool river air drifts inside as you pocket your transit passes.
